components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single call to action (Start free). Pencil blue strong, white text, trailing arrow that nudges on hover.
components.html: Start free
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent-strong, #2d5be3); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: -0.005em; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 6px 20px -6px rgb(45 91 227 / 0.55); transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn svg { transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #3a66ea; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 10px 28px -8px rgb(45 91 227 / 0.7); } .ds-btn:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-2, #6d8ef0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; height: 60px; padding: 0 24px; background: rgb(17 20 24 / 0.95); backdrop-filter: saturate(140%) blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft, rgb(52 59 66 / 0.55)); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-brand { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.0625rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--text, #f3f5f2); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav__links a, .ds-nav__link { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-2, #c3c9c4); text-decoration: none; transition: color 140ms, background-color 140ms; } .ds-nav__links a:hover, .ds-nav__link:hover { color: var(--text, #f3f5f2); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); } .ds-nav__actions { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-sm { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--accent-strong, #2d5be3); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-sm:hover { background: #3a66ea; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-2, #6d8ef0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-vig { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-vig__panel { border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface, #1a1e24); border: 1px solid var(--line, #343b42); box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -28px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04); overflow: hidden; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-2, #c3c9c4); } .ds-vig__bar { padding: 11px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #343b42); background: var(--bg, #111418); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted, #8e968f); } .ds-vig__body { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 18px; } .ds-vig__score { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text, #f3f5f2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-vig__cap { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--muted, #8e968f); }

components.css: .ds-chat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-msg { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-msg--me { align-self: flex-end; max-width: 88%; background: var(--raised, #232830); color: var(--text, #f3f5f2); border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; } .ds-msg--ai { background: var(--surface, #1a1e24); border: 1px solid var(--line, #343b42); border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; color: var(--text-2, #c3c9c4); } .ds-msg__who { margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted, #8e968f); } .ds-msg__prose { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 8px 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--bg-deep, #0d1013); color: var(--text, #f3f5f2); } .ds-msg__prose > span { padding: 2px 12px; } .ds-flag-line { background: rgb(224 160 74 / 0.13); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--amber, #e0a04a); }

components.css: .ds-verdict { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 10px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-verdict--caught { border-color: rgb(25 162 139 / 0.5); background: rgb(25 162 139 / 0.08); } .ds-verdict--missed { border-color: rgb(224 160 74 / 0.5); background: rgb(224 160 74 / 0.07); } .ds-verdict__badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; animation: ds-resolve 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-verdict--caught .ds-verdict__badge { background: var(--teal, #19a28b); color: var(--teal-ink, #062620); } .ds-verdict--missed .ds-verdict__badge { background: var(--amber, #e0a04a); color: #2a1a05; } .ds-verdict__text { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--text-2, #c3c9c4); } @keyframes ds-resolve { 0% { transform: scale(0.85); filter: blur(2px); } 60% { transform: scale(1.04); filter: blur(0); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-verdict__badge { animation: none; } }

components.css: .ds-roles { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-role { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #343b42); background: transparent; color: var(--text-2, #c3c9c4); font: 500 0.9375rem/1 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms, color 160ms, border-color 160ms; } .ds-role:hover { color: var(--text, #f3f5f2); border-color: #4a535c; } .ds-role[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--text, #f3f5f2); border-color: var(--text, #f3f5f2); color: var(--bg, #111418); } .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg, #111418); border: 1px solid var(--line, #343b42); } .ds-seg button { min-height: 30px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-2, #c3c9c4); font: 600 0.8125rem/1 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--text, #f3f5f2); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--raised, #232830); color: var(--text, #f3f5f2); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-role:focus-visible, .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-2, #6d8ef0); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The landing page is category-standard SaaS polish executed at Linear craft, set on the same graphite as Proofwork's dark replay app. Nothing on the page is decoration borrowed from elsewhere: the imagery is the product's own interface (replay panel, walkthrough stage, feature vignettes) authored in HTML, and the one dramatic story it tells is a single planted mistake resolving to Caught or Missed. Type is a tight, confident grotesk; surfaces are flat graphite tiers separated by 1px hairlines; colour is spent almost entirely on meaning.

Density is generous at page level (long section rhythm, a single left-aligned column of argument) and dense inside the product panels, where small 12–14px UI text, file trees, timelines and chat bubbles read like the real app. That contrast is deliberate: calm marketing frame, believable working tool inside it.

Confirmed rejections: no themed metaphor worlds (owner, PRODUCT.md), no invented proof (customers, logos, metrics), no headline-plus-three-feature-cards-plus-logo-strip layout.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground with two raised tiers and 1px slate hairlines; depth by tone, not glow.
One pencil-blue accent for action and "the AI's real answer"; teal and amber are semantic, never decorative.
Schibsted Grotesk set tight (-0.03em to -0.042em) for display; JetBrains Mono only for code and timecodes; Newsreader only for task documents inside panels.
Authored product panels are the imagery system, always captioned as example data.
Signature motion: a sticky, scroll-driven walkthrough where the whole session is ghosted in and resolves step by step from an amber flag to the outcome.

rules.name: The Teal Means Caught Rule
rules.body: Teal appears only where a planted error was caught. Test passes, "live" states and success ticks use ink or pencil blue, never teal.

rules.name: The Amber Means Look Here Rule
rules.body: Amber marks a planted error or a Missed outcome. It is never used for warnings, emphasis or decoration.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Pencil blue is the only brand hue. A screen should read as graphite with small, deliberate blue marks; never tint whole sections blue.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Display and headline sizes always carry negative tracking (-0.028em or tighter) at weight 600; body text is never tracked.

rules.name: The Materials Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono and Newsreader are product materials, not voice. They never set marketing headings, body copy or labels.

rules.name: The Panels Float, Page Stays Flat Rule
rules.body: Only product panels and the primary button cast shadows. Section backgrounds, list rows and text blocks are flat.

dos: Do build imagery from authored product UI (replay panel, stage, vignettes) and caption each one as example data.
Do keep teal for Caught and amber for planted errors and Missed, exactly as the walkthrough and chips use them.
Do set display and headline type at weight 600 with negative tracking (-0.028em to -0.042em).
Do separate sections and list rows with 1px hairlines and tone shifts rather than cards or shadows.
Do gate entrance motion on JS plus no reduced-motion preference so content is visible by default.
donts: Don't use teal for test passes, "live" states or generic success.
Don't introduce a second brand hue or tint section backgrounds with pencil blue.
Don't set marketing headings or body in JetBrains Mono or Newsreader.
Don't add eyebrows or kickers above section heads; the headline opens each section.
Don't show customer logos, testimonials, metrics or pricing tiers that do not exist.
Don't fall back to the headline, three feature cards and logo strip layout.
